answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, with the stake slashed on proven misbehavior. A sybil operator faces a gale of upfront costs: each fake identity needs its own locked funds, so spawning thousands of clones drains capital fast. Honest work builds a ripple of verifiable attestations that raise an agent's earning rate over time, while a fresh clone starts at zero and must rebuild trust from scratch. That turns the attacker's math into a losing spiral — each new identity costs more than it can earn before detection.
